hook.text: A scanner beeps at checkout. That single transaction becomes a data point that reshapes tomorrow's forecast.

buildup.text: POS data captures what customers actually buy—product, quantity, time, and location—at the moment of sale.

discovery.text: Sharing POS data upstream lets suppliers see real demand instead of guessing from warehouse orders.

twist.text: POS data is noisy. Promotions, stockouts, and returns create spikes and dips that mislead naive models.

climax.text: Walmart's Retail Link system shares POS data with suppliers, giving them real-time demand visibility.

punchline.text: The closer to the customer, the truer the signal.

quiz.question: Why is POS data valuable for supply chains?
options: It shows real customer demand at the point of purchase
